title: Nice organizer but no holes for hanging even though screws & mollies are supplied
text:
Nice organizer but no holes for hanging even though screws & mollies are supplied. This is a really nice four-compartment Ziplock bag organizer with one opening each for different types of bags such as quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. I love that the labels are small and embossed on the bamboo.

This is supposed to be able to be hung on the wall or be placed in a drawer that is large enough to hold it; however, it cannot be hung because the three holes for hanging were not drilled in the back. There are three screws with plastic mollies provided and some double-sided tape (or command strips) that can be used to tape to the wall. I do not feel the command strips are a good way to hang this. They should have drilled holes in the back especially since they provided the screws.

I wish they provided some rubberized "circles" for the bottom to keep it from sliding around in a drawer.

Overall, this is an excellent organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in the cabinets. It is definitely an attractive unit. However, since this cannot really be hung well unless holes are drilled in the unit, I consider this a bit of a disappointment. The current price of $23.72 (24.97 minus 5%) is competitively priced. Other options for products like this that are available are this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For those looking to store foil and plastic wrap with their bags, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires.

product_metadata.title: Ziplock Bag Organizer For Drawer With Hanging Strips for Drill Free Mouting | Kitchen Storage Pantry Organizer Compatible with Ziploc Hefty Suitable for Sandwich Bag Snack Quart Gallon Bags
features: DRILL FREE MOUTING - Don’t like drilling? No worries! We’ve included 4 hanging strips for quick and easy mounting on your backsplash or inside the pantry door. And don't you worry about it being strong enough - we tested it! These will stay up with even 2 strips! And we've included 4!

SOLID ONE PIECE CONSTRUCTION - Some ziploc bag organizers come with fancy features such as sliding lids and locks. We tested these and found that they just add unnecessary confusion and bulk. There's plenty of room to get your bags in without the lid! They’re just another thing that can break after the return window closes. Our ziplock bag storage organizer is a solid one piece make-up allowing for full functionality whilst keeping things simple!

SAY GOODBYE TO CLUTTER - Gone are the days of scrambling through your kitchen drawer looking for the sandwich bag, snack bag, quart bag and gallon bags! Gone are the days of cutting your fingers on the sharp edges of thin cardboard boxes. Welcome to the new you. The organized, quickly locating, nifty you who can get any bag in a split second. And thanks to the internal walls separating each section, your ziploc bags will never move out of place!

FITS >99% OF BAGS - Tested with over a hundred different bag sizes, our ziplock organizer will easily fit and is compatible with Ziplock, Glad, Solimo, Hefty, Up&Up, GreatValue and more! Both big name and small name brands - you’re covered!

LIFETIME SOLUTION - Our ziplock bag sizes have been laser engraved into the bamboo so you never have to worry about labels peeling off or ink scrubbing away and having to remember the sizes by heart while your kids make fun of you. Together with the simple one piece construction, this is a true one time investment that you’ll never have to make again.

GIVING BACK - At Olive & Oak, we believe in being there and taking care of each other. That’s why we donate 10% of our profits to registered charities that promote love, acceptance and kindness as well as organizations that undertake humanitarian aid to help those in need.
